description: Whether a file or symbol can be deleted safely: blockers that still depend on it, and files that would be orphaned if it went. A report only — Prism never deletes anything. Prefer this over blast_radius when the question is specifically about removal.

id.description: Workspace-relative file path, or symbol name as returned by find_symbol.

kind.description: Whether `id` names a file or a symbol.

path.description: File declaring the symbol, when kind is 'symbol'.

name: safe_delete
title: Safe delete
